    tsdst.estimators.BayesWeibullRegressor.fit¶

    BayesWeibullRegressor.fit(X, y, status=None)[source]¶

    Fit the model

    Parameters:
    Xnumpy array

    The feature (or design) matrix.

    yarray-like

    Positive event or right-censoring times, in the same row order as X.

    statusarray-like of zero or one, optional

    One indicates an observed event; zero indicates right censoring. If None, all times are treated as observed events.

    Returns:
    self

    Updates internal attributes, such as coef_ and intercept_.

    Notes

    The model estimates log shape as intercept + X @ coefficients and samples one shared log scale. The reported prediction is the conditional Weibull mean. Use predict_shape to obtain the positive shape parameter.
